medicine-shortages.state: ASHP added cytarabine (7 Oct) and irinotecan (12 Oct) injections to its US shortage list, linking part of the rise to flooding at a Pfizer plant in India, a disruption Pfizer expects to last into 2028 (Becker's, 26 Oct). In a September survey every cancer centre reported a shortage and 7% said they could not continue some treatment.
medicine-shortages.for_you: Patients should follow advice from their clinician or pharmacist; the NHS manages UK shortages through Serious Shortage Protocols.
medicine-shortages.rubric_hit: Essential medicine shortage affecting major health systems

sources.title: Becker's Hospital Review — The 2026 chemo shortage: a timeline

exploited-vulns.summary: CISA added 8 exploited vulnerabilities in 7 days, including two in Ivanti
exploited-vulns.state: CISA added eight vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue in the seven days to 30 Oct, including two in Ivanti Connect Secure and one in Cisco's firewall software, and 33 in 30 days, under the 11-a-week Watch line. No emergency directive for mass exploitation was in force as of 2 Nov.
exploited-vulns.for_you: Keep devices and software updated; NCSC publishes guidance on patching.

sources.title: CISA — Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue

aid-funding.value: WFP Gaza aid cut for 500k (19 Oct)
aid-funding.summary: Funding gaps force WFP ration cuts in Gaza and the West Bank
aid-funding.state: WFP said on 19 Oct it would cut monthly food aid in Gaza from 1.6 million to 1.1 million people and halve family rations, after receiving less than half its usual Palestine funding in 2026; it needs $450m for six months. West Bank aid was halved in September (Al Jazeera).
aid-funding.for_you: Funding shortfalls reduce aid in crisis zones. OCHA and ReliefWeb publish appeal details.

sources.title: Al Jazeera — WFP cuts aid to 500,000 Palestinians in Gaza amid funding shortages

uk-supply-margins.summary: GB gas and power margins adequate for winter; no notices issued
uk-supply-margins.state: National Gas said on 23 Oct that GB has enough supply capability (592 mcm/d) to meet 1-in-20 peak demand of 493 mcm/d this winter. NESO's early view forecast a 5.5GW de-rated electricity margin, with some tight days likely in January. No margin notices had been issued as of 1 Nov.
uk-supply-margins.for_you: No sign of supply interruptions to UK homes; the main pressure is on prices, not availability.

sources.title: National Gas — 2026 Gas Winter Outlook
Drax — NESO forecasts lower supply margins this winter

uk-supply-margins.basis_detail: NESO and National Gas system notices

uk-floods.summary: No Environment Agency flood warnings in force
uk-floods.state: The Environment Agency had no severe flood warnings, no flood warnings and no flood alerts in force in England at 17:47 UTC on 2 Nov.
uk-floods.for_you: Check the gov.uk flood warning service if heavy rain is forecast.

sources.title: Environment Agency — Check for flooding

headline: Iran offers to reopen Hormuz within two days if the US lifts its blockade, but Doha talks ended without a deal; Brent eased to near $105. Cyclone Murasu, a GDACS red alert, is due ashore in Andhra Pradesh overnight.

situations.name: US–Iran war and Gulf energy shock
situations.summary: Doha talks ended 1 Nov without a deal; Iran offers to reopen Hormuz within two days if the US lifts its blockade (2 Nov). Brent near $105, TTF near €95.

situations.name: Russia–Ukraine war and NATO's flank
situations.summary: Russia launched 759 drones on 1 Nov and 193 on 2 Nov, cutting power in 10 regions; the Kherson truce ended; drones closed Jersey airspace 30–31 Oct.

situations.name: Super El Niño
situations.summary: ONI +2.2: drought in Australia and East Africa, record warmth and weaker carbon sinks.

situations.name: Ebola outbreak, DR Congo
situations.summary: DR Congo reports more than 5,000 Ebola deaths and 10,300+ cases (2 Nov), with cases in Kenya and Nigeria; a WHO emergency (PHEIC) since May.

situations.name: Sudan war
situations.summary: Record drone attacks on civilians in October; the army rejects talks; famine confirmed in 2025.

situations.name: Cyclone Murasu
situations.summary: GDACS red alert; IMD expects landfall near Ongole, Andhra Pradesh 23:30–04:00 local on 2–3 Nov, winds 100–110km/h; about 30,000 to be evacuated.

situations.name: France: debt stress and protests
situations.summary: OAT–Bund spread about 159bp (30 Oct); hundreds of thousands protested with clashes on 31 Oct, as unrest also hit Germany.

situations.name: Energy shock feeding inflation
situations.summary: US CPI at 4.0% on the oil shock; a Bank of England rise is widely expected on 5 Nov; Egypt hiked on 29 Oct.

situations.name: Record Binance hack attributed to North Korea
situations.summary: About $6.3bn drained from Binance in late October; FBI blamed North Korea; Binance says 95% replaced and withdrawals restored in phases (2 Nov).
